title: AGENT_OUTCOME envelope
description: The structured envelope a factory-produced or hand-authored agent emits as the terminal output of every invocation. Captures only what the agent uniquely knows (status, self-verification result, failure mode, agent-specific assessment, artifact pointers, routing hints). Objective measurements (tokens, latency, cost, model identity) are emitted by the runtime adapter, not the agent. Per AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and AGENTIC_PRINCIPLES.md (telemetry is a system property, not an agent property).

schemaVersion.description: Major.minor version of the AGENT_OUTCOME envelope schema. Adapter parsing is forward-compatible across minor bumps within the same major; major bumps may require adapter version range updates per the version-compatibility matrix in design-shared-002-runtime-adapter.md.

status.description: Terminal status the agent reports for its own work. Mirrors the status field on InvocationResult produced by the runtime adapter. The adapter records this verbatim onto the invocations row.

selfVerification.description: Outcome of the agent's own self-verification step (per AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md: Run your self-verification before emitting). passed indicates the check ran and succeeded; failed indicates it ran and surfaced an issue (typically paired with status: failed); skipped indicates the agent's contract did not declare a self-verification step.

failureMode.description: Enumerated failure-mode identifier when status is not completed. The set of legal failure modes is per-agent and declared in the agent's prompt contract; this schema does not enumerate them centrally. Common values: budget_exceeded, tool_unavailable, guardrail_violation, input_invalid, dependency_missing, internal_error. Null on completed/partial.

agentAssessment.description: Agent-specific structured self-report. Shape varies by role; the per-agent prompt declares the schema for this field. Examples: a critic emits {verdict, findings, confidence}; a builder emits {modulesProduced, linesWritten, testsAuthored, confidence}; an intake agent emits {requirementsCount, ambiguitiesIdentified, blockers}. Free-form object validated by per-agent contracts (not by this universal schema).

producedArtifacts.description: Pointers (URIs, not contents) to artifacts the agent produced during this invocation. Empty array if no artifacts were produced. Each entry identifies one artifact with a stable kind, a URI for retrieval, and optional content hash for integrity checks.

routingHints.description: Advisory next-step suggestions the agent surfaces for the orchestrator. Hints are strictly advisory; the orchestrator may ignore them. Common kinds: retry_self (try this same agent again with adjusted input), escalate_hitl (a human should review), route_to (a different capability is better suited), proceed (results are good enough to advance).

metadata.description: Forward-compatibility bucket. Unknown fields encountered by older adapter versions are preserved here so they survive round-trips. New optional fields the schema introduces in future minor versions land here until the schema is bumped to acknowledge them as first-class.

kind.description: Categorisation of the artifact (e.g., code-module, test-suite, design-doc, intake-document, critic-report, flow-definition). Open vocabulary; per-agent contracts may pin specific kinds.

uri.description: Reference to the artifact's location. Typically a file URI relative to the build directory (file://./src/module.py), an HTTP URL, or a registry reference (registry://knowledge/kv_xyz).

contentHash.description: Optional SHA256 hex digest of the artifact's content. Used by downstream consumers to detect changes between invocations.

description.description: Optional one-line human-readable summary of what the artifact contains.

priority.description: How strongly the agent recommends this hint. low is informational; medium is the agent's best guess; high indicates the agent strongly believes the hint should be honored. The orchestrator may still override.

rationale.description: Short human-readable reason for the hint. Surfaced to the orchestrator for decision logging and to operators via the dashboard.

targetCapabilityKey.description: Required when kind is route_to. The capability key the agent suggests routing the work to (e.g., role:python-domain-expert).
